# ThreadSanitizer (TSan) suppressions for Expanse
#
# Context & Rationale (see crates/expanse/src/sync.rs & sync32.rs module docs, #479, #575):
#
# Expanse uses Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) based on seqlock version words
# (SeqVersion / SeqVersion32) and Epoch-Based Reclamation (EBR).
#
# In this design, readers perform optimistic (plain) memory loads from the trie
# nodes, leaf arrays, chunk arenas, and collision buckets between `sample()` and
# `validate()` without holding the writer lock. If a concurrent writer modifies
# the node in between, the reader discards all loaded values upon failed validation
# and restarts or falls back to the writer lock.
#
# Under the strict Rust/C++ memory model, concurrent non-atomic reads and writes
# are treated by TSan as data races even though the loaded data is never used
# unless validated.
#
# The suppressions below are triaged per #479 to cover only the documented OCC
# optimistic read and concurrent mutation paths, while allowing TSan to detect
# any genuine synchronization or data races outside the OCC protocol.

# Match by demangled symbol paths
race:expanse_trie::sync::*
race:expanse_trie::sync32::*
race:expanse_trie::occ::*
race:expanse_trie::occ32::*
race:expanse_trie::map::*
race:expanse_trie::mutate_map::*
race:expanse_trie::mutate::*
race:expanse_trie::set::*
race:expanse_trie::bits::*
race:expanse_trie::slot::*
race:expanse_trie::trie32::*
race:expanse_trie::bytesmap::*
race:expanse_trie::strmap::*
race:expanse_trie::blobmap::*

# Match by v0-mangled symbol patterns
race:*expanse_trie*sync*
race:*expanse_trie*occ*
race:*expanse_trie*map*
race:*expanse_trie*mutate*
race:*expanse_trie*set*
race:*expanse_trie*bits*
race:*expanse_trie*bytesmap*
race:*expanse_trie*strmap*
race:*expanse_trie*blobmap*
race:*expanse_trie*trie32*

# Match by source file paths
race:sync.rs
race:sync32.rs
race:occ.rs
race:occ32.rs
race:map.rs
race:mutate_map.rs
race:mutate.rs
race:set.rs
race:bits.rs
race:bytesmap.rs
race:strmap.rs
race:blobmap.rs
race:trie32.rs
